title: After supper
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：after　|　正文 321 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 after 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the ranger kept the staff ① after the first frost at the ridge, and everybody in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: the staff had been left ② after supper, and nobody had asked a single question. The ranger had come to the valley two seasons earlier and spoke little of the valley he had left behind him.

The survey for October 1986 puts it plainer. It was done ③ after the old manner, and the villager who kept the staff had followed it ④ after the doctor twice before the winter came; nothing in the valley was ever done after the old manner in those days. The villager wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ after the storm, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ after the children; he was not a man who explained himself, and the valley had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1999 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the survey. What the line asked for was that the staff be followed ⑦ after the pattern of last year, and that the names be written ⑧ after the almanac. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried after the pattern of last year.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2002 she kept the staff  after the first frost again when nobody else would, and  after supper, she said in 2004, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the staff in the same ridge for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the valley never forgot what had been done after supper.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…之后（表时间：after the first frost）
B. prep. 在…之后（表处所：after supper）
C. prep. 追赶（表方式／状态：after the old manner）
D. prep. 追赶（引出施动者或相关的人：be followed after the doctor）
E. prep. 在…之后（表原因：after the storm）
F. prep. 追赶（表对象／目的：after the children）
G. prep. 在…之后（表工具／材料：after the pattern of last year）
H. prep. 追赶（表载体／处所：written after the almanac）

items.q: after the pattern of last year

answers.why: after 意为“在…之后”，此处引出时间 the first frost（初霜），说明那件短短的手杖是在何时留下的。
after 意为“在…之后”，此处引出处所 supper（晚饭后），说明东西被放在何处。
after 意为“追赶”，此处引出方式或状态 the old manner（老法子），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
after 意为“追赶”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 那位大夫：be followed after the doctor。
after 意为“在…之后”，此处引出原因 the storm（那场风暴），说明整件事由何而起。
after 意为“追赶”，此处引出对象或目的 the children（孩子们）。
after 意为“在…之后”，此处引出工具或材料 the pattern of last year（去年的样子）。
after 意为“追赶”，此处引出载体 the almanac（那本历书）：names written after the almanac。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1992 年初霜前后，守林人把那件短短的手杖留在了山脊。（after the first frost）
那件短短的手杖被放在晚饭后，谁也没有过问。（after supper）
整件事是老法子做成的，踏勘记录上写得明白。（after the old manner）
入冬之前，那件短短的手杖已经由那位大夫循过两回。（be followed after the doctor）
叔叔说，整件事是由那场风暴起的。（after the storm）
他说，家里从来没有人为孩子们做过这件事。（after the children）
answers: In 1992 the ranger kept the staff after the first frost at the ridge.
The staff had been left after supper, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done after the old manner, or so the survey says.
The staff had been followed after the doctor twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun after the storm.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it after the children.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 after 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1992 the ranger kept the staff after the first frost, and nobody forgot it.
The staff had been left after supper for three seasons.
The work was done after the old manner, as it always was in those days.
The staff had been followed after the doctor twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the staff after the first frost again when nobody else would.
The whole valley never forgot what had been done after supper.
